debug_level.description: Debug level. 0 is normal, higher values increase detail. Maps to -dl.

debug_module.description: Filter debug messages by module (ALL|ARG|MAIN|TREE|CPPDIR). Maps to -dm.

no_curses.description: Disable curses UI. Useful for non-interactive scripts. Maps to XSTOW_USE_CURSES=0.

use_absolute_paths.description: Create symlinks with absolute paths. Breaks Stow compatibility. Maps to -ap.

traversable_links.description: List of link paths pointing to directories to ignore. Maps to -tr. Items are strings.

tr_keep_targets.description: Add traversable link targets to keep targets. Maps to -tkt.

tr_auto_pattern.description: Pattern to auto-add traversable links (fnmatch). Maps to -tre.

tr_auto_regex.description: Regex to auto-add traversable links. Maps to -tre-regex.

keep_dirs.description: List of directories not to remove when unstowing. Maps to -kd. Items are strings.

ignore_patterns.description: List of file patterns to ignore (fnmatch). Maps to -i. Items are strings.

ignore_regexes.description: List of file regexes to ignore. Maps to -ire. Items are strings.

nignore_patterns.description: Only consider files/dirs matching these patterns (fnmatch). Maps to -ni. Items are strings.

copy_patterns.description: Copy files matching these patterns instead of linking (fnmatch). Maps to -cp. Items are strings.

copy_regexes.description: Copy files matching these regexes instead of linking. Maps to -cre. Items are strings.

ignore_file_in_dir.description: Specific DIR/FILE pairs to ignore. Maps to -ifd. Items are strings.

copy_file_in_dir.description: Specific DIR/FILE pairs to copy. Maps to -cfd. Items are strings.

stow_dirs.description: Other stow dirs allowed to be changed (cross-stow). Maps to -sd. Items are strings.

sd_auto_pattern.description: Pattern to auto-add stow dirs (fnmatch). Maps to -sda.

sd_auto_regex.description: Regex to auto-add stow dirs. Maps to -sde.

protect_dirs.description: Directories XStow is not allowed to change. Maps to -pd. Items are strings.

pd_auto_pattern.description: Pattern to auto-add protect dirs (fnmatch). Maps to -pda.

pd_auto_regex.description: Regex to auto-add protect dirs. Maps to -pde.

protect_targets.description: Directories XStow IS allowed to change (allow list). Maps to -pdt. Items are strings.

pdt_add_traversable.description: Auto-add traversable link targets to protect targets. Maps to -pta.

force.description: Skip conflicts if possible. Maps to -f.

packages.description:
List of package-specific configurations. Items are maps with 'name', 'stow_dir', 'target_dir', 'verbose', 'ignore'.
  name (string): Package name.
  stow_dir (string): Stow directory for this package.
  target_dir (string): Target directory for this package.
  verbose (number): Verbosity for this package.
  ignore (list): List of ignore patterns for this package.
